summary: Record R24 emergency swapchain ClearRenderTargetView work in the R19 swapchain owner before Flush so live Destroy cannot bypass the GPU completion fence.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered vr-d3d9ex-focus HEAD eddaedfcd1789839d60dd447113283835e48ee5c after finalizing 00466 exact-SHA validation. Structural extraction is terminal and ARCH-V3-GATE-001 remains HMD-gated, so the next runnable unit is independent DX9Ex resource-lifetime hardening.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: R19 Destroy skips GPU drain only when gpuWorkSubmitted is false. RenderTo/Draw records it, but R24 BuildEmergencyVisibleQuad issues ClearRenderTargetView directly to Theater.rtvs and Flushes without marking GPU work. A subsequent live destroy/recreate can therefore bypass the completion fence despite swapchain-referencing D3D11 work.
